technical.summary: Mixed technicals with long-term bullish structure but weak near-term momentum, oversold conditions without confirmation, and price below key moving averages limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: WRB shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying engagement, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 36 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (3+ years old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (383.5), flat yield curve, FOMC event today, and financial sector credit stress create severely adverse macro conditions for WRB despite 36-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term bullish structure (SMA 50/200 bullish, OBV bullish, Supertrend bullish) with extreme fear sentiment (11/100) creates contrarian opportunity near support at 40.1888.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis conditions (VIX 383.5, FOMC today, credit stress), zero fundamental conviction, price below all key moving averages, weak trend strength (ADX 19.01), and high earnings risk in 36 days make this a high-risk entry with poor risk/reward.
